de: Spazieren Sie morgens am Treidelpfad des Kanals, um die Ruhe zu genießen.
Prüfen Sie den Kalender für das Stone Food & Drink Festival im Herbst.
Parkplätze am Trent & Mersey Canal sind an Markttagen schnell belegt.
Beobachten Sie das bunte Treiben der Boote von einem der vielen Pubs direkt am Wasser aus.
hu: Sétálj egyet reggel a csatorna partján, ilyenkor a legnyugodtabb a környék.
Nézd meg a naptárat, hátha pont az őszi Stone Food & Drink Festival idején jársz itt.
A Trent & Mersey csatorna melletti parkolók a piaci napokon hamar megtelnek, érkezz korán.
Ülj be egy csatornaparti pubba, és figyeld a hajóforgalmat egy ital mellett.
ro: Plimbați-vă dimineața pe malul canalului pentru a evita aglomerația.
Verificați calendarul pentru festivalul culinar Stone Food & Drink Festival din toamnă.
Parcările de lângă canalul Trent & Mersey se ocupă rapid în zilele de piață.
Găsiți un pub pe malul apei pentru a urmări traficul bărcilor tradiționale.
en: Take a morning walk along the canal towpath before it gets busy with cyclists and boaters.
Check local listings for the Stone Food & Drink Festival if you're visiting in early autumn.
Parking near the Trent & Mersey Canal fills up very fast on market days, so arrive early.
Grab a seat at one of the canal-side pubs to watch the traditional narrowboats navigate the locks.

de.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes
de.tip: Probieren Sie diese herzhaften Haferfladen, traditionell gefüllt mit Käse und Speck, in den Cafés nahe der High Street.

de.name: Lokale Ales
de.tip: Genießen Sie echte regionale Biere in den historischen Gasthäusern entlang des Kanals.

de.name: Britische Pub-Küche
de.tip: Suchen Sie sich ein Gasthaus am Wasser für klassische Fish and Chips oder den sonntäglichen Braten.

hu.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes
hu.tip: Kóstold meg ezeket a sós zabpalacsintákat sajttal és szalonnával töltve a Fő utca (High Street) környéki kávézókban.

hu.name: Helyi sörök (Ales)
hu.tip: Próbáld ki a környékbeli főzdék kézműves söreit a történelmi csatornaparti kocsmákban.

hu.name: Klasszikus pub ételek
hu.tip: Keress egy vízparti fogadót egy jó fish and chipsre vagy vasárnapi sültre (Sunday roast).

ro.name: Oatcakes din Staffordshire
ro.tip: Încercați aceste clătite sărate din ovăz, umplute cu brânză și bacon, la cafenelele din apropierea străzii principale.

ro.name: Bere locală (Ale)
ro.tip: Savurați beri artizanale regionale în pub-urile istorice înșirate de-a lungul canalului.

ro.name: Mâncare de pub britanică
ro.tip: Căutați un han pe malul apei pentru un clasic fish and chips sau o friptură de duminică.

en.name: Staffordshire Oatcakes
en.tip: Try these savory oatmeal pancakes, typically filled with melted cheese and bacon, available at independent cafes near the High Street.

en.name: Local Ales
en.tip: Sample real ales from regional breweries at the historic waterside inns.

en.name: Traditional Pub Grub
en.tip: Look for a canal-side tavern to enjoy a hearty portion of fish and chips or a classic Sunday roast.

de.name: Stone Farmers' Market
de.tip: Findet jeden ersten Samstag im Monat in der High Street statt, ideal für frische, lokale Produkte.

de.name: High Street Boutiques
de.tip: Stöbern Sie in den unabhängigen Geschäften auf der Hauptstraße nach einzigartigen Geschenken.

hu.name: Stone Termelői Piac
hu.tip: Minden hónap első szombatján tartják a High Street-en, remek hely a helyi finomságok beszerzésére.

hu.name: High Street butikjai
hu.tip: Fedezd fel a Fő utca független kisboltjait, ahol egyedi ajándékokat találhatsz.

ro.name: Piața fermierilor din Stone
ro.tip: Are loc în prima sâmbătă a fiecărei luni pe High Street, perfectă pentru produse locale proaspete.

ro.name: Buticurile de pe High Street
ro.tip: Explorați magazinele independente de pe strada principală pentru suveniruri și cadouri unice.

en.name: Stone Farmers' Market
en.tip: Held on the first Saturday of the month on the High Street, it's a great spot to buy fresh local produce and artisan goods.

en.name: High Street Boutiques
en.tip: Browse the independent shops along the main thoroughfare for unique clothing and gifts.

de.name: Trent & Mersey Canal
de.tip: Ein friedlicher Spaziergang entlang des Wassers, bei dem Sie die traditionellen Narrowboats beobachten können.

de.name: Westbridge Park
de.tip: Eine weitläufige Grünfläche am Fluss, perfekt für ein ruhiges Picknick.

hu.name: Trent & Mersey csatorna
hu.tip: Békés sétálóhely, ahol gyönyörködhetsz a hagyományos keskenyhajókban (narrowboats).

hu.name: Westbridge Park
hu.tip: Egy zöldellő park a folyóparton, tökéletes egy csendes délutáni pihenéshez.

ro.name: Canalul Trent & Mersey
ro.tip: O rută pietonală pașnică, ideală pentru a admira ambarcațiunile înguste (narrowboats).

ro.name: Westbridge Park
ro.tip: Un spațiu verde relaxant lângă râu, perfect pentru o pauză liniștită.

en.name: Trent & Mersey Canal Towpath
en.tip: A peaceful walking route where you can admire the scenic waterways and historic locks.

en.name: Westbridge Park
en.tip: A large riverside green space, perfect for a quiet afternoon stroll or a picnic.
